As such, it could (and did) lead to the cancella-

But if Snowden had a large archive of files containing the sources of the NSA's electronic interceptions, as Snowden claimed he had in Hong Kong, there was an enormous potential intelligence upside.
Putin had to choose between the loss of an Obama summit and an intelligence coup. Would Putin have made the choice he did if Snowden had destroyed, or refused to share, the stolen data?

brought to Russia explain why Russia exfiltrated him from Hong Kong and provided him with a safe haven.

The Quickly Changing Narrative

Three weeks after Kucherena's appearance on Shevardnadze's show, on October 17, Snowden had his first interview exchange with a journalist since his arrival in Russia. It was over the Internet with James Risen of The New York Times, as noted earlier. Snowden now asserted a very different narrative. The subsequent front-page story,
